tasks.label: Start JavaFX Desktop
args: if ! pgrep -x Xvfb >/dev/null; then Xvfb :1 -screen 0 1280x800x24 >/tmp/xvfb.log 2>&1 & fi; until [ -S /tmp/.X11-unix/X1 ]; do sleep 1; done; if ! pgrep -f '[x]11vnc.*5901' >/dev/null; then x11vnc -display :1 -forever -shared -nopw -rfbport 5901 >/tmp/x11vnc.log 2>&1 & fi; if ! pgrep -f '[w]ebsockify.*6080' >/dev/null; then websockify --web=/usr/share/novnc 6080 localhost:5901 >/tmp/novnc.log 2>&1 & fi; sleep 2
